events.evidence: At least 45 people are killed and over 100 others are injured when a car bomb explodes in central Baghdad, Iraq.
The United States lifts its siege of the northern Iraqi city of Tal Afar after Turkey threatens to end all cooperation with the U.S. in Iraq
Hurricane warnings are issued for Puerto Rico and the United States Virgin Islands in anticipation of Tropical Storm Jeanne

label.note: Iraq violence, Turkey-U.S friction and hurricane warnings weigh on risk appetite.
